title: RoboAware: Learning to Coordinate Embodied Skills from Counterfactual Outcomes
abstract: arXiv:2610.11480v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Embodied coding agents can combine modular robot skills with frozen end-to-end policies, yet effective composition requires anticipating which policy family will succeed in the current physical state. We present RoboAware, which builds on coding agents' skill orchestration by learning only a state-conditioned responsibility coordinator from counterfactual outcomes. Inspired by the success of REPL, we propose the $P^5$ schema and formulate a hierarchical MDP based on it. $P^5$ organizes skills uniformly into five semantic stages, defining where responsibility can be compared. To address the lack of counterfactual branch outcomes in existing work, we introduce State-Locked Counterfactual Branching (SCB), which restores the same training state to generate and execute a code block from each admissible family, exposing outcomes that selected-branch experience leaves unobserved. translated_title: RoboAware：从反事实结果中学习协调具身技能
translated_abstract: 具身编码智能体可以将模块化机器人技能与冻结的端到端策略相结合，然而有效的组合需要预判哪一类策略家族能够在当前物理状态下取得成功。我们提出了RoboAware，它在编码智能体技能编排的基础上，仅通过从反事实结果中学习一个状态条件化的责任协调器。受REPL成功的启发，我们提出了P⁵模式，并基于该模式构建了一个分层马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）。P⁵将技能统一组织为五个语义阶段，从而明确了责任可以进行比较的位置。为解决现有工作中缺乏反事实分支结果的问题，我们引入了状态锁定反事实分支（State-Locked Counterfactual Branching, SCB），它通过恢复相同的训练状态，为每个可采纳的策略家族生成并执行代码块，从而揭示出仅依赖被选分支经验所无法观察到的结果。在此基础上，我们提出了执行感知学习……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出RoboAware框架，通过P⁵模式、状态锁定反事实分支（SCB）与执行感知学习，仅学习一个状态条件化的责任协调器，使编码智能体能够基于反事实结果有效协调模块化机器人技能与冻结端到端策略的组合。
en_tdlr: RoboAware learns a state-conditioned responsibility coordinator from counterfactual outcomes via the P⁵ schema, State-Locked Counterfactual Branching (SCB), and Execution-Aware Learning, enabling embodied coding agents to effectively coordinate modular robot skills with frozen end-to-end policies.
